Strange Jigsaws is an incredibly clever puzzle game in that "just right" level of difficulty. Though if you are having trouble, the developer also has a website with varying levels of hints to help you along while minimizing any spoilers …
This game was amazing. A wonderful puzzle game. This is what Jonathan Blow would make if he wasn't an arrogant, insane prick.
